passage:
In front of Moon Town Station, there is a yellow mailbox with these words on it: "Letters for Next Year."
People can put letters into the mailbox at any time. However, the post office will not send them right away. The letters will be kept for one year and then sent back to the writers.
Some people write to their future selves. They talk about their dreams, worries, or plans. Some parents write to their children. Some students write before an important exam and read the letter after they enter a new school.
The mailbox has become famous because life often moves too fast. A letter from the past can show people how much they have changed.
Post officer Mr. Chen says many people cry when they receive their letters, but most of them smile afterward. "They are meeting an old version of themselves," he says.
